title: Forming a Texas LLC: the certificate of formation, the name and the fee
rule: A Texas LLC comes into existence when its certificate of formation, signed by an organizer and filed with the Secretary of State, takes effect. The certificate gives the name, the registered agent and office, the initial mailing address, the purpose, the organizer, and whether the LLC has managers, naming them or else the initial members. The name must contain "limited liability company," "limited company" or an abbreviation and be distinguishable from names on file. The filing fee is $300.
changeWatch: Amendments to Business Organizations Code chapters 3 to 5, or a new Secretary of State fee schedule (Form 806, last revised 09/26).
